reserveReview.rationale: Negative search 2026-09-04: cfx.to still states CFX-issued digital assets are redeemable 1:1 for U.S. dollars with USD custody by FDIC Member Banks, and its footer says MoveUSD deposits are held in an FDIC Member Bank beneficiary account, but it publishes no report period or reserve balance. The MoveUSD documentation URL redirects to docs.cfx.to (page updated 2025-10-21) and supplies no dated composition. Independently hosted PR Newswire launch copy is dated 2025-04-01 and states every MoveUSD dollar is backed 1:1 in beneficiary accounts at participating FDIC-insured banks; CoinMarketCap's live page likewise describes 1:1 regulated-bank demand deposits without a report date. No named bank, account-level terms, liquidity terms, or dated independent reserve-to-liability report were found. The 100% bank-deposit slice is retained as the last observed composition: compositionAsOf 2026-07-28 is 38.345 days before fixed capture clock 1788509806 because full dates are midnight UTC, exceeding the 38-day effective bound by 0.345 day; no newer dated publication supports a date change.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: CFX issuer site + MoveUSD docs + independently hosted launch PR + CMC bank-deposit description of MoveUSD USD deposit backing
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The single disclosed reserve category is known, but CFX does not identify the FDIC member bank, publish account-level terms, or provide a dated independent reserve report.
